checked_profile.summary: A comparison marketplace connecting borrowers with participating refinance lenders.
checked_profile.scope: This check covers the marketplace’s role, coverage and compensation disclosure. Individual lenders set loan terms; marketplace-wide rates, fees, approval scores and cosigner rules are not established here.

facts.label: Market coverage
facts.text: Credible compares participating lenders and says it does not include every provider or all of their products. A comparison is not a complete survey of the market.

facts.label: Compensation
facts.text: Credible says it is paid by lending partners and does not charge consumers for its comparison service. Review the chosen lender’s disclosures separately for loan fees.

facts.label: Prequalification
facts.text: Credible describes checking prequalified refinance rates without affecting your credit score. A prequalified result is not a final loan approval; confirm the lender’s application and credit-check requirements.

questions: Which lenders were included for my application, and which were excluded?
Who makes and services the loan I am considering?
What final APR, fees, cosigner terms and repayment options does that lender offer?
